findings.what: The default path still probes Ollama localhost for a configured vLLM backend, so the issue's named non-Ollama false-halt remains unless callers know to inject a separate imperative seam.
findings.why: With PipelineConfig(qwen_vllm_url='http://gpu-node.cluster:8000/v1') and no OLLAMA_HOST/ollama_host, _probe_backend_idle called probe_ollama_idle('http://localhost:11434') and returned False. The CLI only constructs UnifiedPipeline(config) and exposes no backend_probe assignment, so the PR body overclaims that defect 1 is resolved for vLLM/non-Ollama deployments. Resolve the probe from the selected backend/config, or make the non-Ollama probe declaratively configurable through the actual CLI/config path.

findings.what: A bare unbracketed IPv6 host resolves to an invalid HTTP endpoint.
findings.why: resolve_ollama_host('::1') returns 'http://::1'; it neither brackets the address nor appends :11434. Bracketed IPv6 shapes work, but the resolver advertises bare host spelling and has no IPv6 regression case.

findings.what: The scope guard checks source-text presence rather than trigger behavior.
findings.why: The actual diff leaves _had_timeout untouched, but this assertion would still pass if a second condition overrode or bypassed that predicate while the old line remained. It pins spelling, not behavior.

what_i_tried_to_break: Exercised bare host, explicit port, existing scheme, trailing slash, blank/whitespace, bracketed and unbracketed IPv6; traced the CLI construction path; demonstrated a remote qwen_vllm_url still probes localhost; ran all four existing test files that patch socr.pipeline.orchestrator.probe_ollama_idle (69 passed, 2 xfailed); directly verified the module-level patch and custom seam; ran the five new tests plus both config meta-tests (7 passed); copied the new test to the pinned baseline and reproduced two behavioral assertion failures (2 failed, 3 passed), then removed it.
